reason_no_fitting: All three methods are deterministic; parameters were selected only on validation.

validation_tuning.score: mean trajectory edge accuracy, equally weighted by scenario/interval trajectory

metric_definitions.micro_precision_recall_f1: Single-label multiclass micro scores; equal to edge accuracy.
metric_definitions.macro_scores: Unweighted mean of one-vs-rest per-edge precision/recall/F1 over the union of true and predicted edge IDs.
metric_definitions.mean_matching_distance_m: Metric distance from the noisy observation to the predicted road edge, not distance from the true coordinate.
metric_definitions.trajectory_accuracy_mean: Mean of per-trajectory pointwise edge accuracy, giving each scenario/interval track equal weight.
metric_definitions.trajectory_exact_match_rate: Fraction of scenario/interval tracks whose every point edge is correct.
metric_definitions.candidate_count_mean: Mean candidates retained/considered by the algorithm at each observation; Nearest Road checks every edge in that scenario map.
metric_definitions.processing_ms_per_observation: Matcher wall time divided by observations in each track; excludes CSV loading and network construction.
